editorial:
Imagine being a famous star in Hollywood but having a home life that feels like a nightmare. You get to see this exactly in the story, where a successful actress is trapped in a marriage with a husband who is completely out of his mind. He treats her terribly and pushes her way too far, but things take a wild turn when she starts changing into something not human. The movie blends a scary thriller with some crazy fantasy elements, making you feel for the main character while you wait to see how she finally snaps and fights back.

The acting is top-notch, and the way the makeup looks during her change is really impressive. While some parts of the middle feel a bit slow, the big twists at the end make up for it. If you love movies about revenge and monsters, you will really enjoy this one. You should definitely watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gore in detail, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The final scenes show the actress fully embracing her demon form to get revenge. She lures her husband into a trap where he cannot escape and kills him in a brutal way. The big twist is that she doesn't change back into a human after he dies. Instead, she realizes she likes her new power and decides to stay a monster, hunting other bad people in the city as the screen fades to black.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories and creature features.
